描述_EN: carved lacquerware is a labour-intensive craft. by varying the colours of the different layers, here black and red, the finished product shows a marbled effect. layers of lacquer were applied to a wooden core, and only when the first layer was completely dry could the second layer be applied, followed by the third and so on. this wine bowl is made of lacquered wood.
描述_ZN: 雕花漆器是一种劳动密集型的工艺。 通过改变不同层的颜色，这里是黑色和红色，成品呈现出大理石的效果。 一层层的漆被涂在木芯上，只有当第一层完全干燥后才能涂上第二层，然后是第三层，如此循环。 这个酒碗是用漆木做的。
